data.name: Zephira
data.gender_notes: Zephira is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Hebrew, Zephira means 'breeze' or 'west wind'. In the Bible, Zephaniah is a prophet whose name derives from the same Hebrew root as Zephira. The name Zephira evokes images of fresh, revitalizing winds that bring rain. The name Zephira carries the meaning “Breeze, wind bringing rain” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Zephira usually hope their child will grow to embody breeze, wind bringing rain and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the cleansing and renewing power of the Holy Spirit.
data.etymology: Zephira belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Breeze, wind bringing rain.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zephira total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: זפירה
in_hebrew.meaning: היא שואפת רוח מערבית, נושבת רוח
in_hebrew.long_meaning: זפירה היא שם עברי שפירושו 'היא שואפת רוח מערבית' או 'נושבת רוח'. השם מגיע מהמילה העברית 'זפר' שפירושו 'לנשוב ברוח' או 'להביא רוח'. השם זפירה מוזכר בתנ"ך כרוח מערבית, ויש לו קונוטציות של שינוי, התחדשות ותנועה. השם גם משויך לאחד משמות הנשים הנזכרים בספר דניאל.

in_greek.name: Ζεφιρα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ζεφιρα είναι ένα όνομα που προέρχεται από την εβραϊκή λέξη 'זפירה' και σημαίνει 'αυτή που φέρνει δυτικό άνεμο' ή 'αυτή που φυσάει με τον δυτικό άνεμο'. Το όνομα Ζεφιρα έχει συσχετιστεί με την έννοια της αλλαγής, της ανανέωσης και της κίνησης. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, ο όρος 'Ζεφύρι' χρησιμοποιείται για να περιγράψει τον δυτικό άνεμο.

in_latin.name: Zephira
in_latin.meaning: She who brings the west wind
in_latin.long_meaning: Zephira, derived from the Hebrew 'זפירה', signifies 'she who brings the west wind' or 'she who blows with the west wind'. The name Zephira carries connotations of change, renewal, and movement. In early Christian tradition, the west wind was associated with new beginnings and spiritual awakening.

in_english.name: Zephira
in_english.meaning: West wind, zephyr, or gentle breeze
in_english.long_meaning: Zephira is a Christian name derived from the Hebrew 'זפירה', meaning 'west wind', 'zephyr', or 'gentle breeze'. The name originates from the Hebrew word 'זפר', which means 'to blow' or 'to bring wind'. In biblical context, Zephira symbolizes change, renewal, and spiritual growth. Historically, the name has been associated with the west wind, which was considered a symbol of new beginnings and divine inspiration. Today, Zephira remains a popular name among Christian parents seeking a name that embodies spiritual significance and natural beauty.

data.cultural_impact: The name Zephira may carry a sense of gentleness, renewal, and tranquility. It invokes images of the sea breeze, and the refreshing sensation of cool air against the skin, often associated with relaxation and warm-weather destinations. This name could also be seen as a reference to the Greek god Zephyrus, the god of the west wind, who was often depicted as a mischievous and playful deity.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian tradition, the name Zephira carries a deeper spiritual significance. As the name Zephaniah in the Old Testament means 'God has hidden', Zephira can be seen as a reminder of the hidden presence and love of God in our lives. It signifies the gentle and soothing ways in which God reveals himself to us, and can be seen as a reminder to seek His guidance and presence even in the most trying of times. Like the refreshing breeze, God brings new beauty, renewal, and revitalization to our souls.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Zephira is a Hebrew name meaning "west wind." In Christian symbolism, the west wind is associated with the Holy Spirit, signifying renewal and transformation. As such, the name Zephira represents the spiritual journey of growth and rebirth through the guidance of the divine wind.

historical_references.reference: In Greek mythology, Zephyrus was the god of the west wind. Zephira was believed to be his daughter or wife. According to one myth, Zephyrus fell in love with the beautiful nymph Chloris, who was wandering in the countryside, sad because she had never experienced the joys of spring. Zephyrus abducted Chloris and carried her off to a secluded place where he wooed and married her. After the wedding, Zephyrus released her from his embrace, and she was transformed into the goddess of spring, Flora. From that day on, Zephira was identified with the west wind that heralded the arrival of spring.
historical_references.time_period: Classical antiquity, 8th century BC - 4th century AD

historical_references.reference: In Christian tradition, Saint Zephira is a virgin martyr venerated in the Eastern Orthodox Church. She is said to have lived in the city of Antioch during the Roman Empire and was martyred during the persecutions of Emperor Decius (249-251 AD). According to tradition, Zephira was a wealthy and beautiful woman who converted many to Christianity. When Decius issued an edict commanding all citizens to offer sacrifices to the Roman gods, Zephira refused and was imprisoned. She was subjected to various tortures but remained steadfast in her faith. Eventually, she was burned alive in a oven. Her relics were discovered in Constantinople in the 4th century and are now venerated in the Monastery of the Mother of God Peribleptos in Istanbul.
